feature: Temporal offset comparison: a date-time field shifted by whole hours, against now() or a supplied instant, with the hours read from one unlinked lookup row

scenarios.name: a row exactly at the boundary instant is not overdue under <
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — no applicable feature folder (TAP-native: date-time offset against a lookup row; the TCK temporal folder tests Cypher temporal types, which Gryphon does not have)
scenarios.query: MATCH (r:grid_fixtures__leaf)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) LOOKUP p = (:grid_fixtures__node {kind: "policy-gold"}) WHERE a.data.observed_at + hours(p.data.severity_score) < now()

scenarios.name: a row exactly at the boundary instant matches under <=

scenarios.query: MATCH (r:grid_fixtures__leaf)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) LOOKUP p = (:grid_fixtures__node {kind: "policy-gold"}) WHERE a.data.observed_at + hours(p.data.severity_score) <= now()

scenarios.query: MATCH (r:grid_fixtures__leaf)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) WHERE a.data.observed_at - hours(12) >= $t
